context: Dreaming of the next big journey
purpose: Plan the next trip; teach わが国/アフリカ/香港/欧米/神戸/広島/直前/殆ど

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 次は、わが国を出て、もっと遠くへ行きたい。
lines.en: Next I want to leave our country and go farther.
lines.style: restless friend wanting more, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: アフリカのサファリも憧れるね。
lines.en: A safari in Africa is a dream too.
lines.style: friend dreaming aloud, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 香港でショッピングも楽しい。
lines.en: Shopping in Hong Kong is fun too.
lines.style: friend listing options, tone holding steady through the whole line

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 欧米の文化も、深く知りたい。
lines.en: I want to know Western culture deeply too.
lines.style: curious friend, delivery emotionally grounded and unforced

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 国内では神戸の夜景、見たことある？
lines.en: Have you seen Kobe’s night view?
lines.style: friend asking, spoken with a recognizable personal cadence

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 広島でお好み焼きを食べたい。
lines.en: I want to eat okonomiyaki in Hiroshima.
lines.style: friend craving food, each word carrying genuine natural feeling

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 出発の直前まで、ワクワクするよね。
lines.en: You keep buzzing right up to departure, right?
lines.style: friend savoring anticipation, voice clear and distinctly their own

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 殆ど決まってないけど、それが旅。
lines.en: Almost nothing’s set, but that’s travel.
lines.style: easygoing friend closing, tone holding steady through the whole line
